whenToUse: Short texts where mood matters, such as a quote of the day.
Once, when a screen first opens.
whenNotToUse: Large areas or long body text (it's costly).
Services used on many low-end devices.
Notices that must be read quickly.

alternatives.name: Mask Reveal
alternatives.reason: Lines rising from behind a mask.

accessibility: Text is in the document from the start, so screen readers don't wait.
With reduced motion, it shows at once without blur.
The blur finishes within 700ms, so it doesn't hold up reading for long.
Text contrast against the background is at least 4.5:1 in the final state.
